target_customer: Small and mid size advertisers who wanted to buy mobile ad impressions self serve by credit card without salespeople
problem: Mobile advertising required sales calls, long commitments and large minimum spends; LeanMarket offered self serve real time bidding with detailed reporting.
business_model: Demand side platform taking a margin on ad spend, CPM priced with no minimum spend
product_category: Mobile advertising real time bidding platform

founders.name: Cyrus Lohrasbpour
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch says he was the sole founder, unusual for YC; no background given. YC lists team size 2.

competitors.name: Engage:BDR
competitors.what: Launched a self serve real time bidding product in May 2012

technical_complexity.rationale: Real time bidding needs low latency integration with exchanges such as Nexage and MoPub and bidding optimization at scale, hard for one or two people.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations with public exchanges were available to rivals; any edge would come from optimization data that needed scale.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large mobile ad networks added real time bidding in 2012, for example Millennial Media bought Metaresolver in February 2012 and MoPub launched a marketplace. No source shows them targeting LeanMarket.

market_need_then: Mobile RTB was growing in 2012 per AdExchanger and MediaPost coverage; TechCrunch reported advertisers were mostly using Google and Facebook instead of banner ads. LeanMarket's own traction was limited beta.

branding.domain_note: Used the exact word lean.com per the YC listing; lean.com now returns 503 and acquisition terms of the domain are not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Self serve, no salespeople framing from launch coverage

branding.community_and_virality: TechCrunch and VentureBeat covered it in July 2012; no community or merch found.

brand_strength.rationale: Brief launch press but a generic name that overlaps with Lean Domain Search and other lean branded startups.

pivots.from: Self serve real time bidding for display ads
pivots.to: Demand side platform for mobile ads
pivots.why: VentureBeat describes it as a mobile DSP working with Nexage and MoPub; the reason for the shift is not stated

outcome_analysis: LeanMarket launched a self serve real time bidding product in July 2012 and moved to mobile advertising with small beta traffic. PitchBook lists it as out of business after about 120 thousand dollars from an accelerator, and YC marks it inactive. No shutdown announcement or stated cause was found, so the cause is not public and no failure factor is assigned.
notes: The $120K round rests on PitchBook alone; PitchBook says founded 2010 and HQ Palo Alto while YC says Mountain View. YC lists team size 2 but only one founder is named and TechCrunch says sole founder. lean.com returned 503 on fetch. The cause of closure is not public.
